links.comparator_used: GPT-4o (standard general-purpose model), zero-shot; Qwen3 and Grok-3 were also compared
links.outcome: Accuracy of automated T and N staging from esophageal cancer EUS reports
links.effect: Average T-staging accuracy: DeepSeek-R1 91.4% vs GPT-4o 84.2% (Qwen3 89.5%, Grok-3 81.3%). Average N-staging accuracy: 84.2% vs 65.0% (Qwen3 68.4%, Grok-3 51.9%). Chinese without-prompt T-staging: OR 7.84 (95% CI 4.62-13.30, p<0.001) vs GPT-4o.
links.quote: In both T and N-staging tasks, DeepSeek-R1 demonstrated superior overall performance compared to the competitors.
